This will be the first ever competition held in the British Overseas Territory of Bermuda! Everyone of all ages and experience is welcome to participate!

This competition is being supported and made possible by Cubing Frontiers, an organization dedicated to bringing and expanding the hobby of speedcubing to underserved communities worldwide.
